milestones.goal: J1 and J2 run end to end on the fake Fo with real rules, a real ledger and the trace: compose -> evaluate -> dispatch -> poll -> claim -> check (fake calendar) -> verified; held card -> decisions
The real oracle and the judged surfaces: Google Calendar check, trace drawer and export, states, /connect, /about, README, backup take
Verify, review, submit: QA and the judged-path checks, fresh review and bug hunt, security and cleanup, SUBMISSION.md and the trace file, the final take

tasks.title: Store, schema, trace writer and the rules evaluator
tasks.objective: SQLite schema (rules, contacts, tasks, trace_events, oauth), the trace writer (SQLite + JSONL append, token redaction) and the deterministic rules evaluator with its reasons; zod types shared by routes and UI
acceptance: WHEN a trace event is written THE SYSTEM SHALL append it to SQLite and data/trace.jsonl with a timestamp and redact any token-like string
tasks.rollback: git revert the T01 commit; delete data/*.db
tasks.notes: schema lives in lib/schema.ts (a TS string) instead of lib/schema.sql so it ships inside the Next bundle

tasks.title: Fo MCP client with OAuth and a fake Fo for tests
tasks.objective: An OAuthClientProvider backed by SQLite (dynamic registration, PKCE, tokens, localhost redirect), a Fo client wrapper (connect, listTools, ask_fo, get_fo_reply, get_fo_conversation) that logs every call as a trace event, and an in-process fake Fo (McpServer over InMemoryTransport) with scripted replies: complete, confirmation question, never-completing, 401
acceptance: WHEN /api/fo/connect is opened THE SYSTEM SHALL register the client (or reuse it), store the PKCE verifier and return the authorization URL; WHEN /api/fo/callback receives the code THE SYSTEM SHALL exchange it, store the tokens and redirect to /connect
WHEN one real initialize is sent to https://mcp.api.wajo.ai/fo without a token THE SYSTEM SHALL record the server's instructions in the ledger (evidence of the real endpoint)
tasks.rollback: git revert the T02 commit; delete data/*.db

tasks.title: Task runner and API routes
tasks.objective: POST /api/tasks evaluates and stores a task (allowed -> dispatch; held -> wait); /decide applies approve once, approve and add a rule, decline; /poll advances Fo (one get_fo_reply per call, confirmation answered from the approval or surfaced); /check runs the postcondition through a pluggable oracle (fake calendar in tests); /confirm records the manual tick; GET /api/tasks, /api/rules, /api/runs, /api/trace/[id], /api/trace/export
tasks.notes: store.ts and deps.ts hold the row mapping and the route plumbing; /answer added for a question the rules cannot answer

tasks.title: Ledger UI golden path with tokens and fonts
tasks.objective: Tokens and fonts from UI-SPEC §14; the ledger page: top bar with run chip and connection chips, caption, rules strip, compose bar, held card, receipt rows with claim and proof halves and the perforated edge, status discs; polling every 3 s; the verified strip unfold; ?demo=1 seed; FO_MODE=fake labels
acceptance: observe: J1 and J2 run end to end in the browser on the fake Fo, the strip unfolds on verify, the held card offers the three choices
tasks.notes: the seed is the demo task in lib/seed.ts run through the pipeline (no static JSON); fixtures and the view model live in lib/

tasks.title: Google Calendar oracle and the live check
tasks.objective: Google OAuth (authorization code, offline, calendar.readonly) with tokens in SQLite and refresh; events.list within the postcondition window with title-contains matching; the live oracle wired into /check; re-ask Fo once on a miss; the manual tick path; /connect page for Fo and Google with their own error text
acceptance: WHEN the Google token is expired THE SYSTEM SHALL refresh it once before the check; IF refresh fails THEN the row SHALL read 'no calendar connected; confirm by hand'
tasks.rollback: git revert the T05 commit; the fake oracle stays
tasks.notes: Needs the user's Google Cloud OAuth client id and secret in .env.local and their account as a test user; until then the fake oracle serves the states

tasks.title: Trace drawer, run count, export, states and record mode
tasks.objective: The trace drawer (events in order, tool names, the check with the event id, the run-count table, Export trace), ?state= fixtures for every row state and the empty and disconnected ledgers, ?record=1 (toasts docked, no hover-only), Alt+Shift+R reset and Alt+Shift+P replay of the recorded real run, reduced-motion variants
acceptance: observe: every ?state= renders at 390 and 1440; ?record=1 keeps toasts clear of the rows
tasks.notes: replay = a snapshot of a recorded real run (data/replay-run.json) shown read-only with its label; Tailwind moved from the Turbopack loader to PostCSS because the loader broke next/font in dev; devIndicators off for the take

tasks.title: Landing layer: /about, README first screen, wordmark and favicon
tasks.objective: /about with the UI-SPEC §9 landing block; README first screen (one sentence, a screenshot, the video and repo links filled or marked as pending in a way submit check accepts only when filled), the live-vs-simulated table, the disclosure sentence; the wordmark and icon.svg; OG image
acceptance: WHEN a stranger reads /about or the README's first screen THE SYSTEM SHALL say what Receipts is, who it is for and what to do first, in product copy with no buzzwords (B17 cold read)

tasks.title: Backup take on the first working end-to-end path
tasks.objective: Record a backup take of J1 and J2 (fake Fo if the real one is not connected yet, labelled on screen) with the demo script, so a take exists before the freeze
acceptance: observe: a take file exists with the strip unfolding and the held card
verify: observe: backup take recorded and its path written to .prod-build/state.md
tasks.notes: The judged take must be FO_MODE=live; this one is the fallback only

tasks.title: QA: judged-path checks, three demo runs, fresh review and bug hunt
tasks.objective: foldcheck at 1440 and 390 with the action and result named; the axe and screenshot loop over the states; keyboard path; three demo runs in a row with reset; one run on an input nobody prepared; a fresh reviewer and bug hunter over the diff and the contract; fixes through failing tests
acceptance: observe: foldcheck passes at both sizes; three consecutive demo runs succeed on the fake Fo; blocking findings reproduced and fixed
verify: observe: foldcheck json at qa/fold/foldcheck.json passes
tasks.rollback: git revert the fix commits individually

tasks.title: Security gate and cleanup
tasks.objective: Secrets scan (nothing in git, nothing in client bundles), env vars documented in .env.example, zod validation on every write route, token redaction in the export, dependency audit; remove scaffold leftovers, unused files and dependencies by the evidence ladder
acceptance: IF a token-like string appears in a trace payload THEN the export SHALL redact it
WHEN the repository is scanned THE SYSTEM SHALL contain no secret and no data/ file

tasks.title: Submission: SUBMISSION.md, trace file, run count, X post text, submit check
tasks.objective: SUBMISSION.md with the write-up (who it is for, what was built at the event, what existed before, what is mocked), the build note (tools the agent uses, what was added on top, one thing that did not work), the run count with its number, the X post text under 280 characters opening on the judge card; the trace file of the recorded run at submission/trace-<run>.jsonl; README links filled; pb.py submit check passes; rules confirmed with evidence
tasks.notes: The X post and the Discord form are the user's to send; the text and the files are prepared here

tasks.title: Final take with the live Fo and the live calendar
tasks.objective: Once the freeze begins and the user's Fo and Google connections exist: run the demo task three or more times, record the one unedited take with FO_MODE=live and ?record=1, export its trace, and update the run count
acceptance: observe: the take shows the appointment appearing in Google Calendar and the receipt flipping to verified in one unedited take; the trace file matches the take
verify: observe: final take recorded, trace exported, run count updated in SUBMISSION.md
tasks.notes: Needs the user: Wajo OAuth (join code), Google OAuth client, a second mailbox as the clinic
